title: Syracuse housing uses grants, tax credits and nonprofit developers
question: How do grants and housing tax credits reach Syracuse nonprofits and project entities, and which records prove the award, investor equity, cash and completed homes?
bluf: Syracuse housing reaches nonprofit developers by different routes. HUD made separate HOME grants to New York and the City; neither public prime proves a payment to Home HeadQuarters. At completed Moyer Carriage Lofts, New York's permanent-source report names housing and historic tax-credit financing beside brownfield equity, debt, state funds and City HOME. A 2022 state-filed chart names NEF Investment Partners Fund X LP as a 99.99% non-managing member of the project LLC; a later state certificate confirms distinct property holders. The tax credits support private project equity, not federal grant checks. Investor cash, final tax claims, nonprofit accounts and HOME vouchers remain separate records.
evidence_cutoff_note: Official federal, New York State, Onondaga County, Syracuse and nonprofit records checked through October 10, 2026. Two-door HOME comparison uses dated official USAspending prime responses, Syracuse's final PY50 plan revised July 2024, and its FY2025 City audit dated February 26, 2026. The City audit schedule is modified accrual, reports $511,147 of federal expenditures under M-24-MC-360505 and $3,314,435 to subrecipients only across multiple HOME grant years and HOME-ARP; the current prime's $62,803.92 outlay is not voucher-reconciled. Its qualified HOME compliance opinion concerns City rental inspections, not HHQ or Champion. Federal-to-state pass separately uses 2024 CFR, HUD form, HTFC's December 2024 board book and USAspending state prime captured 2026-10-10 19:31 EDT. HCR's February 2025 list includes Champion; its May 2026 list omits it, and the Champion subaward row reports $0 without explanation. Obligation, draw, local-account receipt, state/city award, nonprofit payment and homeowner result remain separate. HHQ's original IRS Form 990 covers the fiscal period through 2025-04-30 and reports filer-wide aggregates, not project-level cash. Moyer's completed-project case uses HCR's FY2025 legislative report and later permanent-source schedule, NPS/IRS tax-credit rules, New York historic-credit guidance, DEC property/cleanup records, and Housing Visions' own project and mission reports; a 2022 project ownership chart filed with NY DEC names NEF Investment Partners Fund X LP as a 99.99% non-managing member, while NEF confirms participation and DEC identifies separate site-title actors. IRS TEOS confirms a 2024 Form 990 for Housing Visions Unlimited EIN 16-1375637; its third-party-rendered IRS XML lists HVC EIN 16-1598458 as a separate related nonprofit. The original parent IRS PDF returned 403, and no standalone HVC return surfaced in IRS copies search. Capital transfers, final ownership, NPS Part 3, Forms 8609 and City HOME voucher remain unjoined.
use_note: For grants, start with HHQ mission and original IRS Form 990, then the federal-to-New York handoff and exact two-door HOME comparison. HUD's HTFC state FAIN M24-SG360100 and City of Syracuse direct FAIN M24-MC360505 have distinct recipients, HOME accounts, plans and audits. The City's $511,147 FY2025 modified-accrual expenditure for its FY2024 FAIN is not a HUD voucher or proof of HHQ payment; its HOME rental-inspection finding is City-specific. HHQ's named PY50 City programmes sit in the CDBG budget, while Champion is an HTFC state HOME project with a current $0 reported subaward and unexplained 2026 active-list omission. For housing tax credits, read Moyer Carriage Lofts: HCR's later permanent-source schedule distinguishes federal LIHTC, federal/state historic credits, brownfield equity, mortgage, state financing and City HOME. The federal historic credit may use a head lease and signed lessor election to a master-tenant partnership; the LIHTC building owner uses Forms 8609/8609-A and passes credit information to partners through K-1. No checked Moyer record names a master tenant or election. Housing Visions' nonprofit mission, the named 2022 NEF Fund X investment-member role, project LLC/property title, actual investor capital and tax claiming are separate records. Keep award, credit, investor equity, draw, payment, 990 and home-result clocks separate.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
